name: – Michael Gahler – After § 31 – Am 4
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Ukraine
part_text: 31a. Stresses that Ukraine’s accession to the EU would have far-reaching consequences for the EU’s agricultural sector by disrupting the balance of the EU internal market and exerting downward pressure on agricultural prices, to the detriment of farmers in the EU; expresses its concern that Ukraine could become the largest beneficiary of the common agricultural policy (CAP) at a time when its budget is expected to decrease, thereby reducing support available to farmers across the EU;
